_engine.provenance: Recorded by sverrejb/docxide-pdf's page-metrics binary over mutool 1.28.4 (2026-09-05). Re-frozen on MuPDF 1.29.0 (PyMuPDF 1.28.0), the engine page_metrics.py drives: only file_100_file_101_redline.text_boundary moved (0.5 = 95/190 -> 105/191) because 1.29 splits one equation line on the LibreOffice render's page 6 that 1.28.4 keeps whole. The ported algorithm over mutool 1.28.4 stext output reproduces 95/190 exactly. SSIM frozen for the same five pairs using upstream tools/target/release/page-metrics at upstream_commit. PNGs are page_001.png etc., rendered through page_metrics._rasterize at UPSTREAM_DPI=150 (get_pixmap(dpi=150, alpha=False), RGB), the PyMuPDF equivalent of the harness mutool draw -F png -r 150; upstream Jaccard agrees to 1e-12. Temporary PNG directories deleted after each pair. Existing Jaccard/text-boundary values unchanged.
_engine.ssim_luma: DynamicImage::to_luma8, Cicp::SRGB BT_709/D65 coefficients [0.21264784, 0.7151792, 0.07217304], float32 FMA (aarch64 neon), rounded to u8; not Pixel::to_luma integer truncation.
